 Print RRB ALP CBT 1 answer key 2026 : The Railway Recruitment Boards ( RRB s) have released the RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) answer key 2026 for candidates who appeared in the ALP recruitment examination under Centralised Employment Notification (CEN) 01/2026. The answer key link has been activated on November 12, 2026, at 7:00 PM on the respective regional RRB websites. Candidates who took the Computer Based Test (CBT 1) between November 3 and November 5, 2026, can now access their question papers, recorded responses and provisional answer keys by logging in to the recruitment portal. The facility will remain available until November 19, 2026, at 11:59 PM. The release of the provisional answer key allows candidates to assess their performance before the recruitment process advances to the subsequent stage. Those who identify discrepancies in the answers published by the RRBs can submit objections within the stipulated deadline. The board has prescribed an objection fee of Rs. 50 per question, along with applicable bank service charges. RRB ALP CBT 1 answer key 2026: Steps to download
 Candidates can access the provisional answer key through the regional RRB website. The login facility requires candidates to enter their registration details and complete the authentication process. The following steps explain how to download the RRB ALP CBT 1 answer key: Visit the official website of the respective Railway Recruitment Board.
 Locate the notification or answer key section on the homepage.
 Click on the link titled 'Viewing of Question Paper, Responses and Keys' for CEN 01/2026 (Assistant Loco Pilot) CBT 1.
 Enter the registration number and date of birth or password in the designated fields.
 Complete the captcha verification, wherever required.
 Submit the login details to access the question paper, recorded responses and provisional answer key.
 Download the available documents and save them for future reference.
 Candidates should verify their responses carefully before proceeding with the objection process. The login facility is individualised, and applicants must use their own credentials to access their examination records. Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the RRB ALP CBT 1 answer key 2026. RRB ALP CBT 1 marking scheme : How to calculate probable marks?
 The provisional answer key also enables candidates to estimate their performance in the first stage of the selection process. Under the prescribed marking scheme, candidates receive one mark for every correct answer, while one-third of a mark is deducted for every incorrect response. No marks are awarded for unanswered questions. Candidates can calculate their estimated scores using the following formula: Estimated score = Number of correct answers − (Number of incorrect answers ÷ 3) For instance, a candidate who answers 70 questions correctly and 15 incorrectly would receive an estimated score of 65 marks. This calculation can help candidates assess their performance before the declaration of the CBT 1 result. However, the provisional score should not be treated as the final result or confirmation of qualification. RRB ALP answer key 2026: How to raise objections ?

 Candidates who find discrepancies in the provisional answer key can challenge the relevant questions or answers through the official objection portal. The RRBs have prescribed a fee of Rs. 50 for each question challenged, in addition to applicable bank service charges. Applicants should select the question they wish to challenge, provide the necessary justification and upload supporting documents wherever required by the portal. The objection must be submitted through the designated online facility within the prescribed timeline. The objection window will close on November 19, 2026, at 11:59 PM. Candidates should avoid waiting until the final hours to submit their challenges, as incomplete applications or unsuccessful fee transactions may prevent the objections from being registered. The RRBs will examine the objections received from candidates before finalising the answer key. Any changes considered necessary following the review will be reflected in the final answer key.
